items.title: Spain's PM blames traffickers after 60,000 migrants reach Ceuta from Morocco
items.description: Spain said most had returned to Morocco by Friday evening, as Italy suspended its Schengen agreement on free movement with Madrid.

items.title: Small insects, big damage: The global ant trade is booming
items.description: Legal or not, the trade in African ants bound for Europe is booming. What do hobbyists find appealing about these insects, and what risks does the trade pose to ecosystems, including power outages?

items.title: Ceuta: Spain says most migrants have returned to Morocco
items.description: Spain's government said that an estimated 48,300 migrants were back in Morocco on Friday evening. Italy has temporarily suspended its Schengen free-travel pact with Spain. DW has more.
